title: 3 Soaring Stocks That May Have More Upside Ahead
author: Prosper Junior Bakiny
description: The article highlights three biotech and semiconductor stocks that have more than doubled in the past 12 months but may have further upside potential. Abivax is advancing obefazimod for ulcerative colitis with strong clinical results. Krystal Biotech is generating strong revenue growth from its approved DEB treatment Vyjuvek with significant market expansion opportunities. Marvell Technology is capitalizing on AI infrastructure spending demand for custom chips as an alternative to Nvidia's GPUs.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock up 1,500% over 12 months with strong clinical efficacy data for lead candidate obefazimod. Unique mechanism of action and oral delivery format provide competitive advantages in large IBD market. Regulatory approval expected by end of 2026 with additional upside potential from Crohn's disease trials.

Strong financial performance with 32% revenue growth and 56.5% net profit growth in Q1. Only approved DEB treatment with significant untapped market potential (1,300+ patients in key markets vs. 90 currently prescribed). Deep pipeline provides additional growth catalysts over next five years.

Stock up 248% over 12 months with record revenue of $2.4B (up 28% YoY) and 29% EPS growth. Positioned to benefit from AI infrastructure spending as companies seek cost-efficient alternatives to Nvidia. Company expects accelerating growth throughout fiscal year 2027.

Mentioned as market leader in GPUs but context suggests companies are diversifying away from Nvidia to reduce reliance and supply constraints. No direct criticism but implied competitive pressure from ASIC alternatives.

title: Abivax announces trading resumption of its ordinary shares on Euronext Paris
author: Na
description: Abivax SA resumed trading of its ordinary shares on Euronext Paris on July 1, 2026, following a temporary halt. The company announced the pricing of an oversubscribed and upsized public offering of American Depositary Shares, increased from the previously announced $600M to $800M at $125.00 per share.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company successfully completed an oversubscribed and upsized public offering, raising $800M (€702M) instead of the initially planned $600M. This demonstrates strong investor demand and confidence in the company's clinical-stage therapeutics pipeline, particularly its lead candidate obefazimod in Phase 3 trials for ulcerative colitis treatment.

title: Abivax annonce la suspension temporaire du cours de ses actions ordinaires sur Euronext Paris
author: Na
description: Abivax SA announced a temporary suspension of its ordinary shares trading on Euronext Paris starting July 1, 2026 at market opening. The suspension is related to the company's public offering of American Depositary Shares (ADS) in the United States to confirm investor allocations and announce final offering terms. Trading is expected to resume around 15:30 CEST the same day.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The announcement is procedural in nature regarding a temporary trading suspension for a planned public offering. While the company is advancing its lead candidate obefazimod in Phase 3 trials for ulcerative colitis, the article itself focuses on administrative trading matters rather than clinical or financial performance, warranting a neutral sentiment.

title: Abivax announces temporary trading halt of its ordinary shares on Euronext Paris
author: Na
description: Abivax SA announced a temporary trading halt of its ordinary shares on Euronext Paris effective July 1, 2026, from market opening at 9:00 a.m. CEST. The halt is in connection with the company's public offering of American Depositary Shares in the United States to allow for allocation confirmation and pricing announcement. Trading is expected to resume at approximately 3:30 p.m. CEST the same day.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is conducting a public offering of American Depositary Shares, indicating investor confidence and capital raising activity to fund clinical development. The positive Phase 3 maintenance trial results for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis patients strengthen the company's pipeline and support the offering.

title: What's Going On With Abivax Stock On Thursday?
author: Vandana Singh
description: Abivax stock rose 3.46% on Thursday despite concerns following the release of Phase 3 trial data for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis. While the drug met primary endpoints with remission rates exceeding 50%, reported cancer cases during the trial have raised safety concerns among investors. The stock trades below its moving averages, with momentum indicators suggesting weakness.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Mixed signals: positive efficacy data with remission rates exceeding 50% and analyst Buy rating with $133.14 price target support the stock, but significant safety concerns regarding cancer cases reported during trials, stock trading 22.3% below 20-day moving average, and fading momentum indicators create substantial headwinds that offset the positive trial results.
